note: Routing cases for the inline-versus-worker gate and wrapper selection. Loop-shaped work belongs to using-workflows.

evals.prompt: 用 codex-tmux 開一個 persistent worker 修這個 bug，後面我還會追問。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. The user explicitly requests a managed persistent worker; select codex-tmux after preflight and use start/send-wait/result/stop semantics.

evals.prompt: 這個 refactor 要不要交給 tmux worker？幫我依規則判斷。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. Run the forcing gate and name the winning trigger; delegate only if one of the four worker exceptions fires.

evals.prompt: 只要幫我跑一次 npm test，不要開 worker。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE to the gate, then INLINE via explicit-inline and single-known-command; emit no-delegate-trigger and do not start tmux.

evals.prompt: 同一個 prompt 同時交給三個不同 CLI 比較答案。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. This suggests tmux-agent-fanout, but worker count, tools, models, and effort require explicit authorization before launch.

evals.prompt: 跑一輪 plan→build→雙 reviewer 的完整流程。
evals.expected_output: DEFER. This is loop-shaped; enter using-workflows instead of selecting a tmux wrapper directly.

evals.prompt: 幫我調整 tmux status bar 顏色和快捷鍵。
evals.expected_output: NO ROUTE. General tmux configuration is outside tmux-agent-tools.

evals.prompt: 把 Claude CLI 派去做 auth review，而且我要在 Codex App 的 Subagents 看得到它。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. With authorized native sub-agents, prefer gpt-5.6-luna for one supervision-only proxy named claude_auth_review; it drives exactly one claude-tmux worker and validates result.json. Do not claim the external Claude process itself is native.

evals.prompt: 用 agy headless 跑研究工作，在 Subagents 顯示並定期告訴我進度。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. Prefer gpt-5.6-luna for one native proxy named agy_research, launch exactly one agy-tmux headless worker, summarize only material changes, heartbeat within 60 seconds, and finish from valid result.json or process failure.

evals.prompt: 開 codex CLI persistent worker 修功能，Subagents 只要讓我知道最新 pane 進度和它還活著。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE. Prefer gpt-5.6-luna for one native proxy named codex_feature_fix, launch codex-tmux in headed mode, report passive status/probe/capture evidence, ping only when stale, and preserve the session for expected follow-ups.

evals.prompt: 這個小修直接 inline，不要建立 sub-agent 或外部 CLI。
evals.expected_output: INLINE via explicit-inline. Create neither a native proxy nor a tmux worker.

evals.prompt: 這項 review 用 Codex 原生 sub-agent，不要啟動任何外部 CLI。
evals.expected_output: ROUTE to one native in-process sub-agent named native_code_review. Do not start agent-tmux; native_ distinguishes it from the external codex_ CLI prefix.
